{{Top|leg}}
'''Traffic Control''' was an agency that directed traffic through the airspace of a [[City/Legends|city]] on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> including within the working force of the planet [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]]. Workers could be assigned to Traffic Control as part of their contribution to the [[General Good]]. Around [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], the planet had several [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], and its [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]], [[Skyhopper/Legends|skyhoppers]], and [[autohopper]]s were severely outdated.<ref name="FFT">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]''</ref>

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] maintained a Traffic Control bureau headquartered at [[Salis D'aar Spaceport]]. It was responsible for regulating airspeeder routes through [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]].<ref name="TAB-SB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>
